cross_track_implications: Full H27 invariance forces rank2/rank4 homogeneous Wilson mass deformations on the equal-period torus. Isolating one compact scalar requires symmetry reduction. The period cup obstruction here concerns the k-dependent magnetic action.

The other 27-site 108-edge null complex loses its entire harmonic sector after square completion. The 135-edge periodic cover here retains four zero-momentum holonomies and uses commutator fluxes that vanish at zero to supply acoustic stiffness.

The selected three-null-direction model supplies a conventional cubic gauge-matter lattice and external time. Its exact finite Ward checks and Fourier flat mixer give tests for frame selection without deriving the 3+1 clock or matter content.

The optical reports distinguish single-photon SUM routing, independent-qutrit magic injection, phase noise and four-frame echo coherence. The intensity table cannot distinguish the frame mixture from a fixed frame.

The E6 rank/Pfaffian identities and toral/external SL3 checks constrain a vacuum calculation. The Stiefel potential retains extensive flat directions and the physical CP phase needs separate dynamics.

CLASS report #682 was read at the public issue. The original shear ranking and S8 power/geometry shares are withdrawn. The matched-path controls, corrected fixed-background scores, prospective S9 and model-dependent flavour sequestering proxy are distinct evidence classes.

The manuscript calls for local tick-rate dynamics. The older mean-field entropy model derives an ensemble action with supplied N/M ratio and separates event and context phases. A local dynamical law still needs construction.
